results.title: Project health (CHAOSS)
results.description: How active and widely carried the project is: the bus factor, the spread over organisations, how change requests and issues are handled, and how often it releases. Informative: shown, not rated.
results.message: 4 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the latest 500 commits of the last 12 months, among 5 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 500 commits of the last 12 months (481 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, the forge does not say which account made a commit, so personal and hidden addresses stay unknown. The largest is an organisation with one author, with 91% of the 464 commits whose organisation is known; 4% of the commits come from 1 of 5 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 149 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 147 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: Not measured: the GitLab API answered with an error (GitLab API 401: {"message":"401 Unauthorized"}).

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: Not measured: no issues were opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 11 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 33 days, counted from the GitLab releases. The latest final release is from 2026-11-18. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.
